item.title: Made in Abyss Mobile Game Delayed Beyond September 2026
item.description:
Made in Abyss: An Irredeemable Journey of Mysteries has been delayed beyond the September 2026 date shown on app stores. The team announced the change on September 10, saying it needs more time to polish the mobile game. A replacement release date has not been confirmed.
The announcement specifically warns that release dates still displayed by app stores do not reflect the actual launch date. Players waiting for the game should therefore treat the schedule as unconfirmed until the team issues another announcement.
The statement provides neither a new month nor a separate regional timetable. It also does not set out a revised list of features or explain individual development problems; the confirmed change is the postponement of the release.
Published by Avex Pictures and developed by Nobollel, the game adapts the Made in Abyss anime into a mobile roguelike. Its earlier English reveal described it as a deck-building game and opened pre-registration.
The official Google Play listing outlines four parts of the adventure: collecting and upgrading character cards, equipping relics found in the Abyss, choosing routes while managing supplies, and fighting the creatures waiting deeper below.
Those systems tie preparation to exploration: cards strengthen the Cave Raider, relics provide additional powers, and route choices alter the course of a run. The game is being prepared for iOS and Android. Further scheduling news will be shared through its official account.

item.title: SAKAMOTO DAYS Mission: Rogue Dawn Launches in Japan
item.description:
SAKAMOTO DAYS Mission: Rogue Dawn launched in Japan on September 11, 2026, bringing Rudel’s character-training and roguelite action game to iOS and Android. The mobile adaptation of the anime is free to download, with optional in-app purchases.
Rudel’s launch announcement introduces a game built around developing characters and then putting those builds into combat. Players can download it through the Japanese App Store or Google Play; the announcement concerns the Japanese release.
Rogue Dawn combines its action stages with character development. Training lets players acquire skills and shape a character’s stats, with support cards and items contributing to the build. That leaves room to focus on particular strengths or work toward a more balanced character.
The official website describes movement-based controls with automatic attacks, designed for one-handed play. Skills change the options available during a run, while support characters can join the fight. The launch materials show familiar faces including Taro Sakamoto and Shin Asakura.
Trained characters can then take on more demanding content. The site’s Challengers Stage pits those builds against harder stages and includes rankings based on how far players progress. Returning to training provides a way to prepare a different or stronger build for another attempt.
The short gameplay video hosted on the official site offers a look at the action:
Watch the official gameplay video.
Rogue Dawn is a separate title from SAKAMOTO DAYS Dangerous Puzzle. Players looking for the new release should check the full Mission: Rogue Dawn subtitle on the store listing. Rudel has not announced a global launch date in this release.

item.title: Azur Promilia Sets September 17 for Its China Wayfare Test
item.description:
Azur Promilia will begin its Wayfare Test in China on September 17, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. UTC+8. The official announcement sets pre-downloads for September 15 and confirms a limited test on Windows PC, Android and iOS.
The Azur Promilia September beta includes payments and will wipe its game data when it ends. Access requires selection; downloading the client does not make this an open beta.
Test access cannot be sold, rented, shared or given away. The team also requires real-name verification and excludes minors from participating. This remains a development build, with progress scheduled to be erased after testing.
The official recruitment instructions say selected participants must use the TapTap ID and phone number entered in their application. The team recommends the TapTap PC launcher for the Windows version. Qualification messages are delivered through TapTap’s inbox.
The Azur Promilia September beta is a new test following the earlier Constant Order CBT2. Its September opening is a China test date, not a global launch date.
Manjuu’s fantasy RPG pairs its characters with creatures called Kibo. The official English website introduces the cast and some of those companions, while the September test notices cover access to the Chinese build.

item.title: Medabots S Opens Global Pre-Registration After Six Years in Japan
item.description:
Medabots S has opened global pre-registration on iOS and Android, more than six years after its Japanese debut. Imagineer’s official announcement on September 4 links to both mobile stores and previews the robot RPG in a new promotional video.
Medabots S global pre-registration is available through the App Store and Google Play. The announcement does not set a release date, and the official account notes that store availability may be delayed.
Watch the official Medabots S pre-registration video
Build a robot squad for 3v3 Robattles The English store description centres on 3v3 command-based battles, known as Robattles. Players assemble robots from a head, right arm, left arm and legs, then fit a Medal that acts as the machine’s brain.
Those parts are also central to combat: players issue commands for individual components and can upgrade the equipment they want to keep using. Destroying the enemy leader’s head wins the battle, making the choice of target part of the strategy.
The listing also promises an original story and returning characters from across the series. It does not specify a complete global launch roster or a schedule for bringing over Japanese collaborations.
The Japanese game launched on January 23, 2020, as confirmed by Imagineer’s original release notice. That notice credits SoWhat as developer and Imagineer as publisher of the Japanese version.
For players who have followed the series outside Japan, Medabots S global pre-registration is the next step toward an English mobile release. Launch timing and the opening content lineup remain details to watch for in Imagineer’s announcements.

item.title: Porsche vs. Bike: NTE Players Are Testing the Limits of the New Vehicle
item.description:
A snowy-road race shared by @Nanari_NTE, which credits Bilibili creator 糊兔兔official, puts the bicycle and Porsche in the same downhill run. Another clip from Marsven follows a bike gathering speed on a mountain road.
Watch the player-made bicycle and Porsche race, shared by Nanari_NTE
These are player-made clips, not official vehicle benchmarks. The downhill footage makes for a fun comparison, but it does not establish that the bicycle is faster than the Porsche in general or give it a confirmed top speed.
Watch Marsven’s NTE bicycle clip
The official September 9 update notice lists the bicycle as Yesteryear. It costs 800,000 Fons at the Ticking Back bike shop, where it is a permanent addition.
The same notice schedules Breezy Tour for September 17 at 10:00 through September 30 at 05:59 (UTC+8). Completing a character’s Cycling Invitation unlocks their bike ride-along interaction; the invitations remain available through Random Encounters after the event.

item.title: New Trailer, Huge Spike: Ananta’s Wishlists Go Vertical
item.description:
Ananta recorded one of the biggest wishlist spikes of Gamescom 2026, with roughly 302,000 new Steam wishlists between August 23 and August 30, according to Alinea Analytics’ estimates. The surge came alongside a fresh trailer and a concrete release date for the anime open-world RPG.
NetEase used Gamescom’s Opening Night Live to showcase new footage. Alinea later placed Ananta third for new Steam wishlists among the games featured at the event, behind The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Songs of the Past and Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons.
That puts a number on the interest surrounding the reveal, although wishlist growth alone does not show how many players will turn up at launch.
The official Ananta website now gives a global launch date of January 15, 2027, with PC, PS5, iOS and Android listed among its platforms. For players who have been waiting for a date, there is finally a specific day to mark on the calendar.
The trailer leans into the game’s urban sandbox: city streets, vehicle action and fast movement between buildings. Developed by Naked Rain and published by NetEase, Ananta brings its anime-styled cast into Nova City, where action sequences share space with everyday city life.
Alinea describes Ananta’s approach as free-to-play with cosmetics-focused monetization. That is another part of the game’s pitch, but the wishlist estimate does not tell us which feature persuaded individual players to follow it.

item.title: FF7 Ever Crisis Marks Its Final Anniversary with Chapter 13
item.description:
Final Fantasy VII Ever Crisis has reached its third and final anniversary, with Chapter 13, The Planet’s End, bringing its adaptation of the original FFVII story to a close. The official chapter trailer sets the update for September 6 at 7:00 p.m. PDT — September 7 at 02:00 UTC — ahead of the game’s October shutdown.
The official Google Play listing now describes the third-anniversary event as live. For returning players, the FF7 Ever Crisis final anniversary leaves roughly a month to catch up before service ends.
Square Enix’s official Final Fantasy video page lists The Planet’s End as Chapter 13. The trailer below previews the concluding chapter and contains late-game story footage.
In his producer’s letter, Shoichi Ichikawa outlined an anniversary send-off with new weapons, gear and seasonal quests, plus customization options for selected existing weapons. Those additions accompany the story finale in the closing content plan.
The same letter set out a three-part adaptation of Before Crisis for July and August, alongside returning events intended to help players who had stepped away catch up.
The end of service notice gives the deadline as October 6, 2026, at 11:00 p.m. PDT, equivalent to October 7 at 06:00 UTC. The shutdown covers both the Japanese and global versions.
Sales of Red Crystals ended on July 7 at 7:00 p.m. PDT. Crystals already held can still be used until service ends, and the team says in-game events will continue to be released and updated until then.
Developed by Applibot and published by Square Enix, Ever Crisis launched on iOS and Android on September 7, 2023, followed by Steam on December 6. The FF7 Ever Crisis final anniversary closes out that three-year run with the original story’s conclusion.

item.title: Astrae Oratio TGS Demo Offers a Choice of Story or Combat
item.description:
Astrae Oratio will have its first playable demo at Tokyo Game Show 2026, with visitors choosing between a story session and a combat session. NC has opened a dedicated event page ahead of the show, which runs from September 17 to 21 at Makuhari Messe in Chiba, Japan.
The RPG is being developed by Dynamis One and published by NC. The Astrae Oratio TGS demo gives attendees a first chance to try the game in person, alongside a stage programme and activities around a booth built to evoke its setting.
According to NC Japan’s announcement, the playable build offers a choice of one of two experiences: scenario or combat. The booth stage will also screen the opening story in a prologue presentation.
A new prologue digest video is scheduled for September 17, covering key material from the opening scenario. Until then, the earlier official character introduction gives a look at the cast:
TGS business days fall on September 17–18, with public admission on September 19–21. Entry requires a ticket; the TGS website carries visitor information.
The event page lists a business card holder for demo participants, a keyring for following the official X account, a lenticular card for subscribing to the official YouTube channel, and a drawstring bag for posting a booth photo on X. A fan is also listed among the items distributed at the booth.
The Astrae Oratio TGS demo is separate from the closed beta registration campaign, whose application window runs until September 21. The show dates should not be read as the dates of that remote test.

item.title: Zenless Zone Zero: Claret and Roxy Bring Vampire Style to New Videos
item.description:
Claret is the head of the Flint family and the Administrative Director of Flint Workshop. Roxy serves as the workshop’s chief smith and Claret’s assistant. Their work also connects them to the new story: a missing shipment of Porcelloy draws the pair and the Proxies into an investigation in Vyrium.
Dark outfits, red eyes and gothic staging give the two agents a distinctly vampire-inspired look. The promotional artwork puts Claret and Roxy together, with red accents standing out against the shadowy setting.
The official Claret character demo, “Don’t Wanna Train, But The Guide’s Already Written,” mixes her workshop role with a theatrical presentation. It is Claret’s showcase, with Roxy appearing alongside her.
The Claret EP takes the musical route. “Link Up” runs for just over three minutes, and its official credits list Ironmouse and monii as the lead vocalists. The video keeps the focus on the pair’s chemistry and vampire imagery.
Both are S-Rank agents, but their banners run in different halves of the update. Claret debuts first as an Electric Armorer, introducing the new specialty. Roxy follows in the second half as a Wind Stun agent.
If you want the full update details, our Zenless Zone Zero 3.2 overview covers their banner order, the new story and free outfits. You can also plan your pulls with the Zenless Zone Zero pity calculator.
